comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Rank Tech: 1
Consumed Gauge: 30
Range: 100
Scatter Range: 45

Requires 2 seconds before the activation.
With advanture job it will take 1 second before the activation.

Effect:
Aside from damage, the target(s) get paralyzed for at least 10 seconds. Higher Trap prolongs the effect. When attacking the target, who is paralyzed, the effect gets shorten!

comments.author: james
comments.body: Any idea on where to get adventure type traps? do i need the required skill "trap"before i will unlock this tech?

comments.author: Wystein
comments.body: As with all techs you can get the basic techs anywhere as long as you meet the skill requirements. And all trap techs do require you to have the trap skill. Some trap techs also require you to have another skill at a specific rank to be able to learn them. When I get home later I will post a link to a Japanese Wiki that has great info on techs.
